_comment: Resist! Maquis cards. Each card has a Hidden side and a Revealed side. 'attack' is the sunburst attack value. 'action' is null when the card shows an X (no action). actionType is one of PLAN, ATTACK, PLAN/ATTACK. Transcribed from Maquis Cards.jpg.

hidden.action: Discard one Spy from your hand to the Hidden discard pile then draw a card from the Hidden deck.

revealed.action: Choose a card from the Revealed pile and place it in your hand.

hidden.action: Flip one or two face-down Enemies at one Mission face-up then discard one of them.

revealed.action: Ignore the effect on the Mission that you choose this round.

hidden.action: +1 attack value for each revealed Maquis in play.

revealed.action: Discard all Counter-guerrillas from this Mission.

hidden.action: Copy the hidden action on a hidden Maquis in play. The phase on the chosen action must match the current phase.

revealed.action: Discard one Enemy from this Mission.

hidden.action: +1 attack value for each revealed Maquis in play.

revealed.action: +1 attack value for each civilian in the Graveyard.

hidden.action: Flip one or two face-down Enemies at one Mission face-up then discard one of them.

revealed.action: Look at the top three cards of the Hidden deck. Discard any of them and put the rest back in any order.

hidden.action: Draw one card from the Hidden deck.

revealed.action: Remove one Spy in your hand from the game.
